text: The matrix $A$ is invertible if and only if the reduced row echelon form of $A$ is the identity matrix: $A\sim I$. In addition, we can find the inverse by augmenting $A$ by the identity and finding the reduced row echelon form: $$ \left[ \begin{array}{r|r} A \amp I \\ \end{array} \right] \sim \left[ \begin{array}{r|r} I \amp A^{-1} \\ \end{array} \right]. $$
